textes.Bienvenue à la ferme apicole des Coteaux: Welcome to the Coteaux Blonds bee farm, a family farm in the Drôme. Apiaries, hives, inspections, treatments, harvests, jars and sales: all its data is here. You help its team: Noémie, the founder, Rémi in the apiaries, Salomé, the bee health technician, Capucine in the honey house and Hervé at the markets. Explore the database to solve the missions.

textes.La ferme apicole des Coteaux Blonds est: The Coteaux Blonds bee farm is a family farm in the Drôme that keeps bees and sells their honey. Its hives are set down in apiaries, places that group several of them. Each hive houses a bee colony, active, weak or dead. Before spring, Rémi, who looks after the apiaries, will go and collect the hives of the dead colonies to house new swarms in them. He wants their name, their breed, their installation date and the apiary to fetch them from.

Honey by honey, she compares the 2024 yield with the 2025 one, and its change as a percentage.
textes.le type de miel (une ligne par type): the honey type (one row per type)
textes.le rendement de 2024 : les kilos de ce m: the 2024 yield: the kilos of this honey harvested in 2024 ÷ the number of different hives that gave some that year, rounded to two decimal places
textes.le rendement de 2025, calculé de la même: the 2025 yield, calculated the same way, rounded to two decimal places
textes.l’évolution en pourcentage : (rendement: the change as a percentage: (2025 yield − 2024 yield) × 100 ÷ 2024 yield, calculated with the unrounded yields, then rounded to one decimal place
textes.par évolution, de la plus forte hausse à: by change, from the biggest rise to the biggest drop
textes.Une ruche récoltée plusieurs fois dans l: A hive harvested several times in the year for the same honey only counts once.
A drop gives a negative change.
textes.Calcule d’abord le rendement de chaque m: First calculate the yield of each honey for each year, counting each hive only once. Then put the 2024 yield next to the 2025 one, using a function that reads the previous row, and only round at the end.
textes.Comment les ruches se classent-elles dan: How do the hives rank within their apiary in 2025?
textes.La ferme apicole des Coteaux Blonds est: The Coteaux Blonds bee farm is a family farm in the Drôme that keeps bees. Each hive belongs to an apiary and adds up the kilos of its harvests for the year. Rémi, who looks after the apiaries, posts each apiary’s 2025 ranking in the honey house. In each apiary, he ranks the hives harvested that year by the kilos of honey they gave.
textes.son poids total récolté en 2025, en kilo: its total weight harvested in 2025, in kilos
textes.son rang dans son rucher : 1 pour le plu: its rank in its apiary: 1 for the most kilos, ties share the same rank and the next rank doesn’t skip (1, 1, 2)
textes.seulement les ruches qui ont au moins un: only the hives with at least one harvest in 2025
textes.par nom du rucher, puis par rang, puis p: by apiary name, then by rank, then by hive name
textes.Le classement recommence à 1 dans chaque: The ranking starts again at 1 in each apiary.
textes.Additionne les kilos 2025 de chaque ruch: Add up each hive’s 2025 kilos. Then rank them, with the ranking starting again at 1 for each apiary, without leaving a gap after ties.
textes.Comment le chiffre d’affaires 2025 s’acc: How does the 2025 revenue add up month after month?
textes.La ferme apicole des Coteaux Blonds est: The Coteaux Blonds bee farm is a family farm in the Drôme that keeps bees and sells their honey. Each sale brings in the number of jars sold multiplied by the price of a jar from its batch. Hervé, who sells the farm’s honey, set himself a revenue target for 2025. Month after month, he wants to see what the month brought in and the total built up since January 1.
textes.le mois de la vente, au format AAAA-MM,: the sale month, in YYYY-MM format, for example “2025-03” (one row per month)
textes.le chiffre d’affaires du mois, en euros,: the month’s revenue, in euros, rounded to two decimal places: the sum of jars sold × the price of a jar from the batch
textes.le chiffre d’affaires cumulé depuis janv: the running revenue since January 2025, this month included, rounded to two decimal places
textes.les ventes de 2025, du 1er janvier au 31: the 2025 sales, from January 1 to December 31
textes.seulement les mois qui ont au moins une: only the months with at least one sale
textes.Calcule d’abord ce que rapporte chaque m: First calculate what each month of 2025 brings in. Then add up these amounts as you go, in month order, without grouping any further.
textes.Quelles ruches produisent plus que la mo: Which hives produce more than their breed’s average?
textes.La ferme apicole des Coteaux Blonds est: The Coteaux Blonds bee farm is a family farm in the Drôme that keeps bees. Its hives house four bee breeds, from Buckfast to Black, and each hive adds up the kilos of its harvests over the two seasons. In spring, Noémie, the founder, will raise young queens from the best colonies. For each breed, she’s looking for the living hives that produced more honey than the average of the living, harvested hives of that breed.
textes.son poids total récolté sur les deux sai: its total weight harvested over the two seasons, in kilos
textes.la moyenne de sa race : la moyenne de ce: its breed’s average: the average of these totals over the breed’s hives taken into account (see Good to know), rounded to two decimal places
textes.seulement les ruches dont le total dépas: only the hives whose total is strictly above their breed’s average
textes.par race, puis par total, du plus grand: by breed, then by total, largest first, then by hive name
textes.Sont prises en compte, pour la liste com: Taken into account, for the list as for the average, are the hives that don’t have the status “Dead” and that have at least one harvest.
textes.Procède en deux temps : calcule d’abord: Work in two steps: first calculate the total of each living harvested hive, then the average of these totals per breed. Finally, compare each hive with its breed’s average.
textes.Dans quel état était chaque ruche à sa d: What state was each hive in at its last inspection?
textes.La ferme apicole des Coteaux Blonds est: The Coteaux Blonds bee farm is a family farm in the Drôme that keeps bees. Each hive is inspected several times per season, never twice on the same day; each inspection records the colony’s strength, whether the queen was seen, and the varroa counted. Before winter, Salomé, the bee health technician, takes stock of all the colonies. For each hive, dead ones included, she wants to review its most recent inspection, to choose those to watch closely.
textes.le nom de la ruche (une ligne par ruche): the hive’s name (one row per hive)
textes.la date de sa visite la plus récente: the date of its most recent inspection
textes.la force de la colonie à cette visite, e: the colony’s strength at this inspection, in frames
textes.1 si la reine a été vue à cette visite,: 1 if the queen was seen at this inspection, 0 otherwise
textes.le nombre de varroas comptés à cette vis: the number of varroa counted at this inspection, an empty cell (NULL) if there was no count
textes.toutes les ruches qui ont au moins une v: every hive with at least one inspection, dead ones included
textes.Une ruche n’est jamais visitée deux fois: A hive is never inspected twice on the same day.
textes.Numérote les visites de chaque ruche de: Number each hive’s inspections from most recent to oldest, with the numbering starting again at 1 for each hive. Then keep only number 1.
textes.Quelles colonies ont perdu au moins 4 ca: Which colonies lost at least 4 frames from one inspection to the next?
textes.La ferme apicole des Coteaux Blonds est: The Coteaux Blonds bee farm is a family farm in the Drôme that keeps bees. A colony’s strength, in frames covered with bees, is recorded at each inspection, and a sudden drop often signals a problem: the colony may have swarmed, lost its queen or succumbed to varroa. Salomé, the bee health technician, is investigating these drops. She wants to find the inspections where a colony lost at least 4 frames since the previous inspection.
textes.la date de la visite qui constate la chu: the date of the inspection that found the drop
textes.la force à la visite précédente, en cadr: the strength at the previous inspection, in frames
textes.la force à cette visite, en cadres: the strength at this inspection, in frames
textes.la perte : la force précédente moins cel: the loss: the previous strength minus this inspection’s
textes.seulement les visites où la force a bais: only the inspections where the strength dropped by at least 4 frames since the same hive’s previous inspection
textes.sans la première visite de chaque ruche,: without each hive’s first inspection, which has no previous one
textes.La visite précédente est celle de la mêm: The previous inspection is the same hive’s one that comes just before, by date.
textes.Une force vide (NULL) ne donne aucune pe: An empty strength (NULL) gives no loss.
textes.Pour chaque visite, lis la force de la v: For each inspection, read the strength of the same hive’s inspection just before: a function looks at the previous row. Calculate it separately, then keep the losses of at least 4 frames.
textes.Quels points de vente ont vendu les quat: Which outlets sold all four honeys?
textes.La ferme apicole des Coteaux Blonds est: The Coteaux Blonds bee farm is a family farm in the Drôme that keeps bees. It jars four honeys (acacia, chestnut, lavender and wildflower) and sells them at markets, at its shop and at a grocery. A sale’s honey is its batch’s. Hervé, who sells the honey, is preparing a gift box of the four honeys. He wants to offer it first at the outlets that sold at least one jar of each honey, over the two seasons.
textes.seulement les points de vente qui ont ve: only the outlets that sold at least one jar of each honey type found in the batches table
textes.Le type de miel d’une vente est celui de: A sale’s honey type is its batch’s.
The sales of both seasons count.
textes.Retourne la question : un point de vente: Turn the question around: an outlet fits if there’s no honey it has never sold. You can also count its different honeys and compare with the number of honeys at the farm.
textes.Quelle part du chiffre d’affaires chaque: What share of revenue does each honey make each year?
textes.La ferme apicole des Coteaux Blonds est: The Coteaux Blonds bee farm is a family farm in the Drôme that keeps bees and sells their honey. Each sale covers jars from the same batch, so the same honey, and counts for the year it took place, not the harvest year. Noémie, the founder, wonders which honeys really keep the farm going. For each sale year, she wants each honey’s share of the year’s revenue, to decide which harvests to develop.
textes.l’année de la vente, au format AAAA (une: the sale year, in YYYY format (one row per year and per honey type)
textes.son chiffre d’affaires cette année-là, e: its revenue that year, in euros, rounded to two decimal places: the sum of jars sold × the price of a jar from the batch
textes.sa part dans le chiffre d’affaires de l’: its share of the year’s revenue, as a percentage out of 100, rounded to one decimal place
textes.par année, puis par part, de la plus gra: by year, then by share, largest first
textes.L’année est celle de la vente, pas celle: The year is the sale year, not the harvest year: a 2024 jar sold in 2025 counts in 2025.
textes.Calcule d’abord le chiffre d’affaires pa: First calculate the revenue per year and per honey. For the share, each row needs its year’s total, without grouping: a sum calculated per year, without merging the rows, lets you do that.
textes.Chaque pot est-il plus cher au kilo que: Is each jar more expensive per kilo than the next size up?
textes.La ferme apicole des Coteaux Blonds est: The Coteaux Blonds bee farm is a family farm in the Drôme that keeps bees and sells their honey. The same honey from the same year is put in 250 g, 500 g or 1 kg jars, each at its own price, but not every size always exists. Hervé, who sells the honey, wants each jar to stay more expensive per kilo than the next size up. To fix his prices, he compares each size with the next one.
textes.la contenance du petit pot, en grammes: the size of the small jar, in grams
textes.la contenance du format juste au-dessus,: the size of the next size up, in grams
textes.l’écart : le prix au kilo du petit pot m: the gap: the small jar’s price per kilo minus the large one’s, rounded to two decimal places
textes.seulement les paires de formats qui se s: only the pairs of consecutive sizes, of the same honey and the same year
textes.par année, puis par type de miel, puis p: by year, then by honey type, then by small jar size
textes.Le prix au kilo d’un pot est son prix ×: A jar’s price per kilo is its price × 1000 ÷ its size in grams.
textes.Le format juste au-dessus est la plus pe: The next size up is the smallest larger size: without a 500 g jar, the 250 g jar is compared with the 1000 g jar.
textes.Associe les lots entre eux : même miel,: Match the batches with each other: same honey, same year, larger size. Then leave out the pairs with an in-between size, then calculate the gap in prices per kilo.
textes.Quelles alertes varroa n’ont pas été sui: Which varroa alerts weren’t followed by a treatment?
textes.La ferme apicole des Coteaux Blonds est: The Coteaux Blonds bee farm is a family farm in the Drôme that keeps bees. A hive that counts more than 9 varroa at an inspection is over the alert threshold: it must be treated within 30 days. Salomé, the bee health technician, is checking that this rule was followed. She wants to find the alert inspections that weren’t followed by any treatment of the same hive, to explain these slip-ups to the bee health association.
textes.les visites qui ont compté plus de 9 var: the inspections that counted more than 9 varroa, 9 not included
textes.seulement celles après lesquelles la ruc: only those after which the hive got no treatment started within 30 days
textes.Un traitement suit la visite s’il commen: A treatment follows the inspection if it starts on the day of the inspection or within the next 30 days, the 30th day included.
textes.Seuls comptent les traitements de la mêm: Only the same hive’s treatments count.
textes.Garde les visites au-dessus de 9 varroas: Keep the inspections above 9 varroa. For each one, ask whether there’s a treatment of the same hive started between the inspection date and 30 days later; a date function adds days to a date.
